test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘COMMUNITY’ is written as ‘YITUNMCOM’ and ‘AUTHORITY’ is written as ‘YITORHAUT’. How will ‘ISOLATION’ be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First, second and third letters → Shifted to the seventh, eighth and ninth position respectively.
 
• Fourth letter → Shifted to the sixth position.
 
• Fifth letter → Shifted to the fourth position.
 
• Sixth letter → Shifted to the fifth position.
 
• Seventh letter → Shifted to the second position.
 
• Eighth letter → Shifted to the third position.
 
• Ninth letter → Shifted to the first position.

​So,

 
• ‘COMMUNITY’ is written as ‘YITUNMCOM’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/764f10c23942736d2c8bf6446bdd3ead7d4a8b36f138d2b86e49c48eb6a97e52.png] 

​And,

 
• ‘AUTHORITY’ is written as ‘YITORHAUT’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8ca59508fd88c2295e6b59c1547eb9e1b5f9f279b566830353845f63378e696d.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• ‘ISOLATION’ is written as :

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/529b075f575b55e8b607583edb556bfb94904290fd1f68f3914cce9fceaaaebd.png] 

Hence, **"NIOATLISO**" is the correct answer.

4c:Tf8
